persons.name: Jagajjyotirmalla
persons.evidence: śrīmajjagajjyotyir adhīśvarasya nideśam āsādya ... labdhvādeśaṃ guṇagaṇanidheḥ śrījagajjyotir īśāt

persons.name: Vaṃśamaṇi
persons.evidence: saṃgītaśāstrasya cakāra ṭīkā śrīmaithilo vaṅśamaṇir manīṣāṃ

persons.name: Indu
persons.evidence: labdhvādeśaṃ guṇagaṇanidheḥ śrījagajjyotir īśāt | saṃgītādyaṃ samalikhad asau bhāskaraṃ vijña induḥ

relations.evidence: śrīmajjagajjyotyir adhīśvarasya nideśam āsādya guṇottarasya | saṃgītaśāstrasya cakāra ṭīkā śrīmaithilo vaṅśamaṇir manīṣāṃ
labdhvādeśaṃ guṇagaṇanidheḥ śrījagajjyotir īśāt | saṃgītādyaṃ samalikhad asau bhāskaraṃ vijña induḥ

date.as_written: nepālābde śaśiśaramunivyañjite śuklapakṣe | puṣye gaṇḍe suragurudine drākṣapakṣe daśamyāṃ

notes: Vaṃśamaṇi (a Maithila scholar) composed the commentary (manīṣā) on the Saṅgītabhāskara under King Jagajjyotirmalla, and the scribe Indu copied it under the king's order in NS 751 (śaśi = 1, śara = 5, muni = 7).
